sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tokujiro the Glutton (牛飲の徳次郎) is an optional Shura Samurai Mini-Boss in Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice, with two Deathblow Counters. He is located in Ashina Depths.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: He is a large and corpulent man, who wields an odachi. Met in the Hidden Forest, he's found drinking sake with some Monkeys.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Hidden Forest: on the slope leading to the tree behind the Mist Noble's temple.
